Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). Xuedou Liang owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師左右視，擬對之。善叱曰：竚思停機，情識未透，何曾夢見？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷)). Cuiyan Kezhen owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師擬對，悟劈口擊之，因墜一齒，即大悟，留天寧。

Occurrences.Kwic: 師擬對，鑑掩其口。師了然開悟，遂禮拜。

Occurrences.Kwic: 汝記得話頭麼試舉看。師擬對。鑑掩其口。師了然開悟遂禮拜。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (續傳燈錄). Touzi Yiqing owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師有時顧視僧曰：「鑒。」僧擬對之，則曰：「咦。」叢林因目師為顧鑒咦。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (雲門匡真禪師語錄). Yunmen Wenyan owns the exact clause in the complete case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰：生從何來？李擬對，師揕其胸，曰：祇在這裏思量個甚麼？

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The biography names Li Duanyuan as the person about to answer before the identified master presses his chest.

Senses.Explanation: to be on the point of answering. One rebuke names the preceding delay directly: after the student looks from side to side and makes to answer, the identified master says that lingering thought has not passed through. Other transmission accounts place a blow or a covered mouth at this same turn and then report awakening. The word records the attempted reply; it does not name the interruption or its result.
